E. Varrick Structural Group v. Omundsen Steel (citation proposed in an earlier internal draft). NOT LOCATED. CONCLUSION. As of this memorandum, the research desk has identified NO verified controlling authority for the Pass-Through Indemnity Question in either candidate jurisdiction.
